segments.text: Yeah, so I just got off with Northstar Manufacturing. They’re good with the 42 seats, one-year renewal, same start date of February 1.

segments.text: Yeah, that tracks. Send me the agreement ID and I’ll sanity check the billing lines before it goes to their AP team.

segments.text: Agreement ID is 7146-R. Billing contact is Denise Alvarez, dalvarez at northstar-mfg.com. PO is not required, she said just reference cost center 4102.

segments.text: Got it. Any change to support tier or implementation services?

segments.speaker: Chris, Sales Ops
